_comment: The Star Wars pack with no pictures: every name, rule, unit, character, mission and map position as it ships, the art set and its media left out (PACK.md). A start for renaming into a setting of your own.
summary: The original's rules, map, forces, characters and missions with every name still in place and no pictures - a starting point for a setting of your own.

victory_tips._comment: The Multiplayer Options tooltips, manual p162, verbatim.
victory_tips.standard:
Rebel Win Conditions: Capture Coruscant and capture Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader.
Imperial Win Conditions: Destroy the Rebel headquarters and capture President Mon Mothma and Luke Skywalker.
